title: REQ · A pure helper reports tracked node_modules paths from a file listing
summary: trackedNodeModulesPaths filters a listing to node_modules paths at any depth
description: Context: no helper exists yet to identify dependency paths in a git ls-files listing. Desired behavior: pure function returning only entries with a node_modules path segment. Why: the cleanup and guard both need it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mixed listing, when filtered, then only paths with a node_modules segment are returned
Given a listing without node_modules, when filtered, then an empty array is returned
technical_constraints: Pure function, segment match not substring match
